title: CPMigrate Configuration
description: Configuration file for CPMigrate - Central Package Management migration tool

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for IDE autocomplete

conflictStrategy.description: How to handle version conflicts: Highest (use latest), Lowest (use earliest), or Fail (stop migration)

backup.description: Whether to create backups before modifying files

addGitignore.description: Whether to add backup directory to .gitignore

keepVersionAttributes.description: Whether to keep Version attributes in project files after migration

mergeExisting.description: Whether to merge into an existing Directory.Packages.props file

outputFormat.description: Output format: Terminal (rich UI), Json (for CI/CD), Sarif (GitHub code scanning), Markdown (CI job summary or PR comment), or Csv (spreadsheet analysis). Sarif, Markdown, and Csv require --analyze.

baseline.description: Path to the accepted-findings baseline. Findings it records are reported but do not fail the build, so CI gates on new problems only. Generate with: cpmigrate --analyze --write-baseline

failOn.description: Lowest finding severity that fails the build during --analyze. Info fails on any finding; Never reports without gating. Does not suppress exit 8 for an incomplete scan.

rules.description: Per-rule policy applied before --fail-on. Each key is a rule ID as published in JSON issueCode and SARIF ruleId (run 'cpmigrate --explain all' to list them); each value is either a severity or 'none' to switch the rule off. A disabled rule reports nothing at all, unlike a baseline, which keeps accepted findings visible. Rule IDs and severities are matched case-insensitively; the spellings listed here are the canonical ones. Names are listed as properties rather than constrained with propertyNames so an editor offers them without a differently-cased but perfectly valid policy failing schema validation — an unknown rule ID is rejected by the tool itself, with a message naming it.

enabled.description: Whether automatic backup retention is enabled

maxBackups.description: Maximum number of backups to keep

excludeDirectories.description: Directories to exclude when scanning for solutions in batch mode

rulePolicyValue.description: A severity to re-grade the rule to, or 'none' to switch the rule off. The tool trims surrounding whitespace and matches case-insensitively, so the pattern below accepts any casing while the enum branch is what an editor offers for completion. Listing only canonical spellings would reject a config the tool runs perfectly well.
